title: Humanoid Robots Are About To Replace Everyone
hook: In less than five years, humanoid robots will walk among us in public.

scenes.text: In less than five years, humanoid robots will walk among us in public.
scenes.visual_prompt: futuristic sleek white humanoid robot standing among humans in bustling modern city street, photorealistic

scenes.text: Major tech titans are already deploying bipedal androids in factories that never tire or complain.
scenes.visual_prompt: automated gigafactory assembly line with robotic arms and humanoid workers under neon lights

scenes.text: Equipped with advanced multimodal neural networks, they learn physical tasks simply by watching human video.
scenes.visual_prompt: close up of glowing robotic android face with synthetic blue eyes and intricate micro-circuitry

scenes.text: The jobs of repetitive labor will vanish overnight. The only safe humans are those who know how to command the machines.
scenes.visual_prompt: human programmer interacting with holographic 3d AI neural code in dark cybersecurity center

scenes.text: Are you preparing for the AGI era or will you be caught off guard? Drop your thoughts below.
